answer: Nobody is waved through free: 21 letters of reference, each one priced at £33 is the price, and the vine never covers it twice. The gate stays shut to ghosts because the toll is real. One purse cannot stretch across a hundred tolls, so the farm stalls at the gate. One walnut, one entry. spiral stays on the record.
